thread:
oliver: heads-up - after upgrading to rw-python-sdk v1.6.0 some customers report interleaved timeouts on short concurrent calls (chat/embeddings). looks like connection reuse + async semaphore interactions.
meera: saw the first report this morning. stack traces show client-side TimeoutError with pool_wait in the log. can you paste an example?
oliver: snippet:
```
2026-03-22T11:02:12Z ERROR req=7f4 pool_wait=410ms inflight=96 pool_max=128 error=TimeoutError: operation timed out after 5s
2026-03-22T11:02:12Z DEBUG pool: leases_active=32 idle_sessions=6 reap_interval=60
```
dan: interestingly, mean TLS handshakes/sec increased concurrently. looks like session_lifetime default changed in #452. did we lower SESSION_LIFETIME?
meera: yes PR 452 reduced SESSION_LIFETIME to 90s to aggressively clean idle sockets. the idea was to free sockets for low-traffic tails, but with bursty short requests it causes churn.
oliver: repro script attached (small variations allowed):
```
# quickbench.py
async def run():
    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(worker()) for _ in range(300)]
    await asyncio.gather(*tasks)

async def worker():
    for _ in range(400):
        await client.generate("x")
```
Run with uvloop and you see errors on v1.6.0 but not on v1.5.x.
meera: short-term mitigation: bump RW_POOL_SEMAPHORE and SESSION_LIFETIME env vars in deployment. that restored stability in our canary.
dan: long-term we should: 1) make SESSION_LIFETIME adaptive (increase when short-request ratio > 0.7), 2) add type hints for PoolConfig so env parsing mistakes are caught (we saw strings vs ints passed through k8s), 3) add an async integration test exercising thousands of tiny requests.
meera: also adding telemetry: pool.acquire_wait_ms, lease_recycles, tls_handshakes to SDK metrics so SRE can alert earlier.
qa-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-python-sdk/issues/429 with logs, bench script, and suggested revert-and-adaptive plan.
build-bot: opened PR #461 to expose RW_ENABLE_ADAPTIVE_LIFETIME=false default and add PoolConfig typing in public API.
oliver: cheers. please note onboarding docs need explicit recommended envs for chat-heavy apps; many customers copy defaults and hit this. I'll add a devex quickstart note.
dan: I'll own the adaptive reaper prototype + tests. thanks team.
